definition: shows that you do or decide something after considering another fact; "in the light of" is the British form
exampleSentence: In light of the new evidence, the case will be reviewed.
exampleTranslation: Dựa trên bằng chứng mới, vụ việc sẽ được xem xét lại.

definition: at the start of a situation or series of actions; formal
translation: trước hết, ở bước đầu tiên
exampleSentence: In the first instance, please contact your manager.
exampleTranslation: Trước hết, vui lòng liên hệ quản lý của bạn.

word: as far as I can tell
definition: used to say you think something is true, although you may not know all the facts
exampleSentence: As far as I can tell, the problem is with the battery.
exampleTranslation: Theo những gì tôi thấy, vấn đề nằm ở pin.
